findings.reason: a second plan that succeeds in the same batch would make the retry re-write a plan whose version already advanced, and no assertion in the single-plan case would catch it.
findings.text: §9's done-when moves one plan between two sprints, so a retry handling only the pending plan is indistinguishable from one that re-writes every moved plan (or that records success after completing only one of several pending plans), while the receipt field and the retry loop are per-plan lists
